as_main_text: The world of slots has gone a bit mad! So many people have been playing that all the scatters have gone missing. And it's scatters that are the most important part of the game - they play a vital role in helping players win. You need to travel to the Spinverse to collect all the scatters and make your way to the very center, where a 20,000-euro jackpot awaits! Once you manage that, all the slots will start working again. We're all counting on you, are you up to the task?
as_main_text_2: Your journey to the center of the Spinverse has begun! You reach the first level and see a whole library packed with symbols, and among them your first scatter is hidden. All these symbols look so vivid and familiar, but how on earth can you find the lost scatter? There's too many of them, what are you going to do? That's when you see something moving... it's a helpful wild! You tell it all about the broken slot machines, and it helps you find your first scatter. Now you've got a good friend who'll help you on your journey as you set off together.
as_main_text_3: You and your new helper set off to the next level. This place is populated with elves whose job it is to spin all the reels. They're very dutiful workers, and they're a little annoyed to have someone come in and disturb them. You'd better explain yourself quickly. You tell them, "We're here for a reason! We're looking for missing scatters so we can fix all the slot machines and people can start playing again!" The elves are surprised, their angry looks are replaced swiftly with something much kinder as they resolve to help you find your next lost scatter.
as_main_text_4: As you head to the next level, you are greeted by an ancient wise man, whose job is to invent names for new slots and enter them in his ancient gaming tome. He's old enough to know the entire history of slots from the dawn of time. It is clear that he already knows what you're here for. Once upon a time, many many years ago, when slots had first appeared, a hero just like you had to collect scatters from across the Spinverse to get the machines going. Now, your job is to follow that hero's path. The wise old man helps you find the final mega scatter and you head on further!
as_main_text_5: Finally, you and your wild friend reach the very center of the Spinverse. You unpack all of the scatters you found, and the reels begin to spin again, the cogs all fall back into place, and the slot machines begin to work again! You hear the jingle of coins as the jackpots begin to flow once again, and all the symbols explode with color! Well done!

ggw_mission_1_text: Welcome to the most luxurious casino in Spinwood city! You'll be able to find everything you could possibly want here, including modern slot machines, the best tables with your favorite games, and mountains of chips and cash. You've been lucky enough to have been offered the job of a concierge here. With the holidays approaching, the casino is preparing to welcome many guests who may approach you with various demands and unique requests.
ggw_mission_2_text: The casino is all decked out for the festive season! You're in your element: you kindly open the doors of luxury cars, assist ladies with their dresses and always help guests with their requests. It's business as usual. Finally, you receive your first important task - your boss wants you to clean and polish his favorite Cadillac this evening. You take his car to the cleaners and on your way back, you notice something in the rear-view mirror: a bag filled to the brim with freshly printed new bills.
ggw_mission_3_text: You return to the casino in the squeaky-clean Cadillac and leave the money where you found it, even if was tempting to keep it for yourself at first. Lucky, the boss' right hand man, shakes your hand and says: "Good job - you passed the test. The casino is growing, and we need reliable people like you on our team. Just remember, never ask too many questions. You're not just a concierge anymore, you're going to be a messenger as well! And now that I can trust you not to peak inside, your new task is to deliver the bag with a message to our competitors."
ggw_mission_4_text: The message was delivered. The competitors aren't too happy with the reply and the time has come for some important negotiations. What's more, the holidays are just round the corner and the number of guests in the casino keeps growing! You're quickly becoming someone the boss can trust, and you're able to take on more responsibility. Lucky, however, isn't a fan of this, and your position is somewhat at risk. Your future depends on your next task: will you stay a mere messenger or earn your place in the casino's inner circle? You're about to head off to the negotiations with the boss and his team.
ggw_mission_5_text: The negotiations didn't go so well. The boss was wasn't best pleased with Lucky's behavior, he overstepped the mark and acted like he owned the place. The boss approved of your tactics, however, and he's decided to officially promote you. Do you know what that means? You've made it into the casino's inner circle. Some more time goes by, and you're discussing casino affairs with the owner and the involved parties. Your boss looks tired. He invites you in and says the following, life-changing phrase.
ggw_mission_6_text: Your bet won! Congratulations! You've worked so hard to get here - all the way from a mere concierge to the owner of a huge gambling business! Sometimes you can hardly believe your eyes when you look in the mirror: an expensive mink coat, fancy clothes, the embodiment of wealth... Not too long ago, you were just a concierge in uniform who would bid farewell to yet another rich businessman staring back at you. {br}Now that's quite an achievement! You're a big shot in this town, now. Will you become the richest person in Spinwood and keep the casino afloat? Or will you lose everything you earned and have to start again from square one? {br}That's all up to you now. Good luck!
